name: vultax-research
description: Vi Assistant: inspect a prediction market, calculate hypothetical price scenarios, and cite Vultax research.

interface.shortDescription: Market evidence, explicit scenarios, and published research.
interface.longDescription: Give Vi an exact Polymarket link to inspect resolution rules, outcome prices, spread, liquidity, volume and a bounded recent-trade sample with source timestamps and a matching Vultax workspace link. Calculate hypothetical price scenarios with explicit contract quantities and dollar costs. Search Vultax studies and retrieve articles and datasets with sources and observation context. Public snapshots may be delayed; research is historical. No API key, private account access or trade execution.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Polymarket link with Vi and show its rules and evidence.
For 100 contracts bought at 0.50, calculate exits at 0.40 and 0.60 with one dollar each in entry and exit costs.
Find Vultax research on Polymarket copy-trading costs.
